rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for a card connected to a credit account and used for purchases.

example.english: I usually use my credit card when I go shopping.
example.traditional: 我出街買嘢通常都係碌信用卡。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ceot1 gaai1 maai5 je5 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hai6 luk1 seon3 jung6 kaat1

rows.note: Use this Hong Kong variant mainly in written contexts or when matching the spelling used by a particular bank or document.

example.english: The bank notified me that my credit card will expire at the end of next month.
example.traditional: 銀行通知我張信用咭將於下月底到期。
example.jyutping: ngan4 hong4 tung1 zi1 ngo5 zoeng1 seon3 jung6 kaat1 zoeng1 jyu1 haa6 jyut6 dai2 dou3 kei4
